Bun is an all-in-one toolkit for JavaScript and TypeScript apps. It ships as a single executable called bun. At its core is the Bun runtime, a fast JavaScript runtime designed as a drop-in replacement for Node.js. It's written in Rust and powered by JavaScriptCore under the hood, dramatically reducing startup times and memory usage.
